events.event_name: Relative Arts Indigenous NYFW Watch Party
events.address: Relative Arts, 367 E 10th St, New York, NY 10009
events.what_it_is: A free Indigenous New York Fashion Week hub at Relative Arts with livestream watch parties, pop-ups, new merchandise, and opening-day DJs and performances.
events.what_is_free: Admission to Relative Arts and the Indigenous NYFW livestream watch party is explicitly free. Merchandise in the shop is for sale; no take-home giveaway is promised.
events.caveats: The Indigenous NYFW organizer explicitly says the Relative Arts programming is FREE TO ATTEND. This is distinct from the separately ticketed Indigenous NYFW runway shows and invite-only designer brunch.
events.practical_notes: Relative Arts independently confirms its address and Thursday–Sunday 12–6 PM hours. The Indigenous NYFW event schedule states the livestream watch party runs at Relative Arts throughout September 10–13 during those hours.

events.brand: White House Black Market × Saint Coffee
events.address: Saint Coffee, 201 7th Ave, New York, NY 10011
events.what_it_is: A one-morning White House Black Market Fashion Week pop-up at Saint Coffee with a fall-collection preview and complimentary refreshments.
events.what_is_free: Complimentary coffee and black-and-white cookies are consistently advertised. NYC Plugged also advertises a signature WHBM shirt to take home, but quantity is not guaranteed.
events.caveats: This event is supported by multiple current event listings rather than a located first-party WHBM event page. NYC Plugged explicitly labels it Open to the Public; promotional items should still be treated as quantity-limited unless the brand states otherwise.
events.practical_notes: Current sources agree on Friday, September 11 from 8 AM–1 PM at Saint Coffee, 201 Seventh Avenue. No RSVP or approval requirement is stated.

occurrences.details: Grand reopening programming includes pop-ups, DJs and performances in addition to the Indigenous NYFW livestream.
